POSITION OPENING: Department Chair, Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering
The College of Engineering at The Ohio State University invites applications and nominations for the position of Chair of the William G. Lowrie Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering (CBE).
Review of applications will begin on October 1 and the position will start as early as July 2027.
For more information, please visit the job listing.
POSITION OPENING: Endowed Dietz Chair in Chemical Engineering
The William G. Lowrie Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering at The Ohio State University invites applications for the endowed Dietz Chair, a tenured Professor appointment in the William G. Lowrie Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering, College of Engineering, The Ohio State University.
The area of materials and/or energy, including areas such as catalysis, reaction engineering, batteries, and/or membranes, with an emphasis on experimental research.
For full details, please visit the job listing page.
POSITION OPENING: CBE Assistant Professor - AI Materials
The William G. Lowrie Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering and Department of Materials Science and Engineering at The Ohio State University invite applications for a tenure-track faculty position at the rank of Assistant Professor in the area of Artificial Intelligence. This is a joint appointment with a 70% tenure-home appointment in Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering and a 30% appointment in Materials Science and Engineering. The anticipated start date is August 2027, although a later start date may be negotiated.
For full details, please visit the job listing.
